name: KALPATARU LIMITED
summary: Kalpataru Limited, through its subsidiaries, operates as a real estate development company in India. It engages in the development of residential, commercial, and retail projects; and integrated townships, lifestyle gated communities, and redevelopments in the Mumbai metropolitan region and Pune. The company was formerly known as Kalpataru Homes Limited and changed its name to Kalpataru Limited in February 2008. Kalpataru Limited was founded in 1969 and is based in Mumbai, India.
